title: Soft landscaping minimum 15% of the site
text: Landscaping. C1.2.1 Development to provide a minimum 15% soft landscaping per site with a minimum dimension of 1m (refer Figure 1.2a). C1.2.6 The soft landscaping percentage of C1.2.1 may be reduced to 10% where a significant existing tree is retained on site. Note: a retained tree replaces the tree planting provision in C1.2.4 on a like-for-like basis.

exceptions.label: C1.2.6 significant existing tree retained on site: soft landscaping reduced to 10%

replaces.note: R10-R25 open space 60/55/50% -> site cover plus 15% soft landscaping (C4P1-150)
tree-retention reduction to 10% no longer limited to single houses and grouped dwellings (C4P1-013)

notes: from: ch3 C1.2.1. Test unchanged; coding R10-R60. Soft landscape per A1. 'Per site' is the whole development site (site.area_m2), apartments having no individual sites. C1.2.6 exception: the reduction to 10% now reads as available to apartments because the Part C words 'for single houses and grouped dwellings' are gone; the register (C4P1-013) cannot tell whether that is intended (verify). The retained tree replaces a C1.2.4 tree like-for-like.

verified.note: C1.2.6 (p11) is unqualified by dwelling type in the apartments chapter, so the 10% reduction applies to apartments.
